confirmed.statement: All 15 recorded outcomes concern ratings of participants' written narratives. Each narrative was independently scored by ten human raters, and both drafts also received AI evaluations; these are output scores, not self-reports.
confirmed.locator: PDF pp. 5-7, Sections 2.3, 2.3.1 and 2.4; pp. 16-19, Figures 1-4.

confirmed.statement: The human_raters classification is supported: the ten raters were undergraduates with creativity coursework and awards, using a standardized rubric while blind to condition. The paper does not describe them as domain experts or professional evaluators.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 6, Section 2.3.1; codebook Section 6, Measure.

confirmed.statement: The four dimensions use 9-point ratings. Calibration used 15 narratives; formal interrater reliability was ICC = 0.722, 95% CI [0.48, 0.88], using a two-way mixed-effects model with absolute agreement and average measures.
confirmed.locator: PDF pp. 5-6, Sections 2.3-2.3.1; S1-O1 and S1-O2 measure_detail.

confirmed.statement: DeepSeek-V3 supplies the automated robustness scores: test-retest r = .547, and correlations with human scores are .342 for first drafts and .501 for final drafts. The one-week interval concerns rescoring existing narratives, not delayed participant work.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 6, Section 2.3.2; p. 9, Section 3.3; p. 17, Figure 2.

confirmed.statement: S1-O1, S1-O5, S1-O7, S1-O9 and S1-O11 correctly use with_ai and AI availability yes: their AI-follow and AI-parallel treatment arms used AI during final drafting.
confirmed.locator: PDF pp. 6-7, Section 2.4; codebook Section 1.

confirmed.statement: S1-O2, S1-O6, S1-O8, S1-O10 and S1-O12 correctly use after_ai and AI availability no: AI-first participants wrote the final draft independently after AI-assisted first drafting. Their retained access to the first draft is explicitly disclosed in the form.

confirmed.statement: S1-O13 and S1-O15 through S1-O18 correctly use with_ai and AI availability yes: AI-first and AI-parallel first drafts were produced with AI. Calling first drafts baseline in the paper does not make these pre-assistance outputs.
